unit_notes.art-4:131: Five-year knowledge and twenty-year outer limit separately; discretionary refusal; finality defers short period only; transition preserved; corrected cross-reference to 4:130(3), not nonexistent (4).
unit_notes.art-5:1: Offence versus offender; natural-person disposal/acceptance and legal-entity sphere criteria kept separate; co-perpetration, guilt and leadership distinguished; actual 2023 holdings read.
unit_notes.art-5:2: Three definitions; punitive aspect versus mere burden; standalone instruction excluded; neither sanction classification nor exclusion decides all appealability.
unit_notes.art-5:3: Scope gateway a/b; 5:4 through 5:10 only, separate own scope 5:10a; no implied extension by policy.
unit_notes.art-5:4: Competence and antecedent offence/sanction descriptions separately; temporal analysis and favourable law cross-reference 5:46(4)/Sr1(2) verified.
unit_notes.art-5:5: Justification versus excuse; extent/temporal limits; urgent necessity example does not justify indefinite continuation.
unit_notes.art-5:6: Concurrent repair sanctions for same offence prohibited; successor measures and collection questions separated; no generalized ban on fine combination.
unit_notes.art-5:7: Manifestly imminent violation, concrete proof and existing competence; first-offence prevention distinguished from recurrence.
unit_notes.art-5:8: Independent norms not internal labels; total sanction proportionality; precise CBB 7.2 conclusion and prior grouping noted.
unit_notes.art-5:9: Facts and violated norm; place/time of detection distinct from offence dates; special requirements verified.
unit_notes.art-5:10: Recipient and statutory exception; collection authority not new debt; 5:37 decision before demand and 4:115 ground checked.
unit_notes.art-5:10a: Separate silence and pre-interview caution; objective test; compelled statement excluded from punitive evidence; employee capacity and no automatic all-document immunity.
unit_notes.art-5:11: Lawful person-specific designation, task scope and sanction competence distinct; media case is a first-instance contextual example.
unit_notes.art-5:12: Carry, show immediately on request and minimum contents separately; no assertion of unverified ministerial card model or automatic evidentiary invalidity.
unit_notes.art-5:13: Concrete necessity and scope; routine supervision need not await proven offence; CBB and media case bounded.
unit_notes.art-5:14: Source and direction of restrictions; no power expansion; distinction internal work agreement/designation limitation.
unit_notes.art-5:15: Enter versus search; dwelling/resident consent exception; strong arm does not override it; companion not independent inspector.
unit_notes.art-5:16: Information demand versus casual question; third-party/task limits; secrecy and caution cross-references verified.
unit_notes.art-5:16a: View recognized identity document; October 2026 external source version checked; no inherent copy/retention authority.
unit_notes.art-5:17: Business meaning/digital form; copying and temporary removal conditions; written receipt; no general seizure or confidentiality immunity.
